notes: Fastest farmer and elite split-pusher who burns mana and punishes mana-reliant heroes with Mana Void; needs space and a team that can stall. Weak early and to lockdown that stops Blink (Axe Call, Duel, Rupture, Chrono, Doom).

Blink + Berserker's Call is one of the best initiations in the game, and Counter Helix shreds illusion and summon heroes. Strong lane bully who falls off late; kited by ranged harass and undone by saves like False Promise.

Fiend's Grip is a long single-target disable that pierces spell immunity, so it locks down a BKB carry; Nightmare adds pick and save utility. Grip is a channel, so it can be interrupted, and Counterspell or Rubick can reflect or steal it.

Snowbally skirmisher: Thirst hunts low-HP heroes and Rupture punishes blink and mobility heroes. Pairs well with forced movement (Lasso, Swap, Skewer). Falls off late and struggles vs Reincarnation, saves, and sustained right-click.

strongVs.note: Frostbite + Crystal Nova catch the immobile Sniper
AoE slows and Freezing Field punish illusions

notes: Lane-strong support with a root, AoE slows and team mana regen (Arcane Aura). Freezing Field is devastating behind big AoE lockdown. Very slow and fragile, so she is easily caught by gap-closers and invisible gankers.
Ranged mid-game carry with elite right-click DPS and Multishot, strong for fast tower-push lineups. Very immobile, so she needs peel and frontline and is punished hard by gap-closers and divers.

Premier teamfight initiator: Fissure zoning plus a Blink Echo Slam that scales with the number of enemy units, making him the go-to answer to illusion and summon heroes. Needs Blink timing, and Rubick stealing Echo is a real threat.

Reliable carry with a strong lane (Blade Fury spell immunity), Healing Ward sustain and split-push. Omnislash deletes isolated squishies but is wasted on illusions, and he loses straight duels to Troll-style right-clickers.

Most-picked support of the 7.41 pro meta (mostly pos4, also pos5): Sacred Arrow gives long-range picks and Moonlight Shadow sets up team-wide invisible engages or escapes. Nerfed in 7.41f; fragile, and Moonlight is countered by true sight (Haze, Track, Gem).

High-skill scaling carry: Waveform and Attribute Shift make him slippery and hard to burst, and Morph lets him borrow an enemy hero's basic abilities. Io Tether is his classic enabler. Silences, Doom and mana burn shut him down.

Farm-hungry core with fast Raze waveclear, an armor-reduction aura and Requiem teamfight burst. Played mostly as pos1 in pro. Nerfed in 7.41f; zero escape, so he is vulnerable to catch and lane bullies like Viper.

Illusion army carry who spreads damage, burns mana with Diffusal and escapes with Doppelganger; strong vs single-target heroes. Hard-countered by AoE: Counter Helix, Echo Slam, cleave, Timbersaw and Bristleback quills.

Elusive tempo mid with Dream Coil initiation, Waning Rift silence and top-tier mobility (Orb, Phase Shift). Punishes blink heroes, but silences and lockdown (Last Word, Crippling Fear, Doom) kill him.

Roaming pick-off hero: Meat Hook and Dismember isolate immobile targets, and he gets tankier with Flesh Heap and Meat Shield. Relies on hook accuracy and vision. Loses to %max-HP damage (Lifestealer, Ursa) and kiting.

Lane-dominant, easy-to-execute core: Static Link drains right-click carries' damage and Eye of the Storm pushes towers fast. Strong in the early and mid game but weak to kiting, magic burst and heal-denying sustain like Necrophos.

AoE initiator played mostly mid in pro: Burrowstrike stun plus a Blink Epicenter that wrecks illusions and clumped teams, with good waveclear and a Sand Storm escape. Epicenter now has only a cast point, not a channel; he falls off late.
Mana-fuelled Ball Lightning diver who picks off backliners and scales into a slippery late-game threat. Hard-countered by mana burn (Anti-Mage), Rupture, silences, and Nyx.

Cleave carry with an AoE Storm Hammer stun and huge God's Strength damage, great vs illusion and summon lineups. Combos with Empower, Tether and Swap. Kited or neutered by evasion, disarm/ethereal and Winter's Curse.

Avalanche + Toss burst-stun kills squishy heroes. Tiny is flexible between a tree-grab right-click carry (common pro pos1), a burst mid, and a roaming support. Classic Io tether-toss combo. Slow attack and struggles when kited.

strongVs.note: Nether Swap pulls an ally out of Chronosphere
Point-target Magic Missile stops Waveform escapes

notes: Aggressive lane support: Magic Missile stun, armor-reducing Wave of Terror and a damage aura for ranged pushes. Nether Swap pulls an enemy into the team or saves an ally. Also an occasional pro carry. Fragile; she needs vision to use Swap well.

Flexible core/support: Shackleshot is a long stun that pairs with trees or units, Windrun evasion blanks right-click carries, and Focus Fire gives her carry damage. Vulnerable to magic burst and silences.

Spammable magic nukes plus global Thundergod's Wrath. His true sight reveals invisible heroes, and Static Field chunks high-HP targets. Zero escape beyond Heavenly Jump, so he is a prime target for divers and magic-resistant cores.

Tanky teamfighter: Tidebringer cleave, Torrent and X Marks combos, and Ghost Ship for AoE stun and damage delay. Strong mid-game fights, but ranged mid lanes and magic-immune right-clickers give him trouble.

Heavily contested at TI 2026 (nerfed in 7.41f): elite magic burst (LSA, Laguna) plus Fiery Soul right-click lets her play mid, carry or support. Squishy and immobile, so she needs protection from divers and Anti-Mage's Counterspell.

Two disables (Hex, Earth Spike) plus Finger of Death for easy pick-offs; Mana Drain instantly kills illusions. Very fragile and falls off late, so he relies on Blink positioning and on setting up his cores.
Best-in-class single-target lockdown (Hex into Shackles) and Mass Serpent Wards that take towers in seconds. Great for early push lineups. Shackles is a channel, and he is fragile to gap-closers.

Guardian Sprint + Slithereen Crush initiator whose Corrosive Haze gives huge armor reduction and true sight, making him a hard counter to invisible heroes. Falls off late and is kited by ranged lanes.

Durable frontliner whose Blink Ravage is one of the best AoE teamfight engages; Kraken Shell shrugs off harass. Pair with AoE follow-up. Rubick stealing Ravage and break or pure damage are his main problems.

Teamfight support: bouncing Paralyzing Cask, heals, Maledict, and a Death Ward that shreds anything held in place by Chrono, Black Hole or Call. The Ward is a channel, so stuns, silences and divers answer it.
Lane-dominant support with Frost Shield and Sinister Gaze for peel, and Chain Frost for teamfight damage. Strong early and reliable throughout, but low mobility makes him a target for divers.
Permanently invisible ganker: Blink Strike, Smoke Screen silence and Backstab burst delete isolated supports. Hard-countered by true sight (Haze, Zeus, Track, Gem) and AoE.

Blink Black Hole is one of the strongest AoE lockdowns in the game and pierces spell immunity; a strong pro offlaner in 7.41. Needs AoE follow-up (Death Ward, Freezing Field, Requiem). Global Silence and Rubick punish it.
Rearm-based burst and split-push mid who controls the map with March of the Machines, Deploy Turrets and Boots of Travel. Punished hard by gap-closers, global heroes and mana burn.
Extreme-range right-click poke and high-ground siege with Shrapnel and Assassinate. Needs a frontline and peel. Any gap-closer or invisible ganker kills him.

Sustain-heavy flex core (Death Pulse heals, Heartstopper aura, Ghost Shroud); Reaper's Scythe executes and delays buyback. Eats strength heroes and physical melee. Countered by anti-heal (Ice Blast), silences and mana burn.
Teamfight support: Fatal Bonds, heals, Upheaval and a Chaotic Offering AoE stun that drops a Golem for frontline. Strong in clumped fights, but slow and fragile vs divers.

weakVs.note: Shallow Grave and heals undo Primal Roar pick-offs

notes: Pro offlaner with early pressure from Razorback and rooting Raptors, plus Primal Roar, a spell-immunity-piercing single-target disable for picks. Wants to end early before fights turn into big AoE brawls.
Tempo mid with short-cooldown Blink and AoE magic burst (Scream, Sonic Wave) who dives supports and rotates early. Falls off late. Silences and Rupture shut her down.
Lane-bullying poison support/offlaner with slows, Plague Wards for vision and push, and a Noxious Plague that punishes clumped teams. Falls off late and has no escape.

Late-game carry whose Chronosphere (default ult again since 7.41 removed facets) wins fights and pins mobile heroes. Pairs with ranged AoE damage that works inside Chrono. Rubick stealing Chrono is a disaster.

strongVs.note: Burst like Finger of Death is wasted on Reincarnation

notes: Simple, tanky right-click carry with lifesteal, a stun, Bone Guard skeletons and Reincarnation (no mana cost at max level). Strong in pubs, rarely picked in pro. Anti-heal, kiting and early mana burn (Reincarnation still costs mana at levels 1-2) are his weaknesses.
Premier tower-pusher: Exorcism spirits siege buildings, and Spirit Siphon plus Silence help her skirmish. Wants to force fights at towers early to mid game and falls off if the game drags.
Crit-burst assassin carry: Phantom Strike and Blur let her jump squishy targets. Evasion blanks many physical cores. Countered by armor, pure or magic damage (Helix, Timbersaw), ethereal and kiting.
